description: This file defines the class DefaultActivityCheckConfig which provides configuration settings for activity checks in a policy entity, specifically managing inactivity and deletion intervals, loaded from a configuration source.

classes.name: DefaultActivityCheckConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ActivityCheckConfig that loads inactivity and deletion intervals from configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a DefaultActivityCheckConfig instance from a given Config object.

methods.name: getInactiveInterval
methods.description: Returns the configured duration for inactivity timeout.

methods.name: getDeletedInterval
methods.description: Returns the configured duration for deletion timeout.
